comment: On JDK 22+, WindowsDefault picks dev.dirs.impl.WindowsForeign (from the JDK 22
multi-release section of this JAR), which calls into Windows via the
java.lang.foreign API. Native images need those downcalls registered upfront,
else they throw MissingForeignRegistrationError at run time on Windows.
These are WindowsForeign's only downcalls: CLSIDFromString(void*, void*) and
SHGetKnownFolderPath(void*, int, void*, void*). Both return C long, which is
32-bit on Windows, hence 'int' (WindowsForeign's C_LONG is ValueLayout.JAVA_INT).
WindowsForeign's C_POINTER is ADDRESS.withTargetLayout(...), which native-image
Note that callers also want --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED, otherwise the
image warns about the restricted System.loadLibrary / Linker calls on each run.
